# AL Muraqib Fiber Glass Industry L.L.C

> GRP/FRP manufacturer in Sharjah, UAE (est. 2016, ISO 9001:2015, Dubai Municipality
> approved). Designs, moulds, finishes, assembles, installs and repairs glass-reinforced
> plastic products in-house: panel & cylindrical water tanks, plunge pools & aquapark
> features, RCC tank/piping GRP lining, chemical & epoxy flooring, GRP ducts and scrubbers,
> septic & sewerage systems, planters, custom fabrication. Quotation-driven B2B — no
> published price list. WhatsApp/phone quote intake available on every page.
